title: Police seize P6.5-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes in Misamis Occidental

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A pre-dawn checkpoint operation in Misamis Occidental thwarted an attempt to transport nearly P6.5 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes bound for Central Luzon, leading to the arrest of two couriers early Tuesday. Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) reported the seizure of 8,116 reams of “Modern” brand cigarettes at a border control point in Brgy. Silanga, Tangub City, at around 3:10 a.m. Acting on intelligence that a Mitsubishi wing van traveling from Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay to Bulacan province was carrying contraband, a joint police team flagged down the vehicle.
